dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.QueryMetricsRe.title: Query Metrics Request
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.QueryMetricsRe.description: QueryMetricsRequest is the request type for the Query/Metrics RPC method. Empty request body as metrics are retrieved from the latest block state.

metrics.description: Operational metrics from the most recent block including execution counts, gas usage, subscription activity, and performance indicators.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

executed_total_gas.description: Sum of actual gas consumed by executed tasks

executed_total_fees.description: Sum of fees charged for executed tasks (per denom)

executed_task_count.description: Number of executed tasks (DONE or FAILED via execution path)

pending_task_count.description: Pending-queue metrics captured at block start Number of tasks in PENDING at BeginBlock

pending_gas_requested.description: Sum of task_gas_limit across PENDING at BeginBlock

pending_oldest_scheduled_ts.description: Minimum scheduled_timestamp among PENDING at BeginBlock (0 if none)  (removed) pending_highest_gas_price

dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.Metrics.title: Metrics
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.Metrics.description: Metrics tracks aggregate statistics for crontask executions
